title: Which country will win the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
background: The Women's T20 World Cup is the International Cricket Council's world championship for women's national teams in Twenty20 cricket.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official tournament final result published by the International Cricket Council, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve when the winner of the 2026 tournament is established by the final's official result. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
